label: Hắc Long
description: a fierce kung-fu master called the Black Dragon: long black hair tied in a high topknot with loose strands, a short black goatee, a sleeveless black kung-fu jacket with gold frog buttons and a coiling gold dragon embroidered on it, a red sash belt, loose black trousers, black kung-fu shoes, black leather wrist guards

portrait.prompt: Now something different: NOT a sprite sheet. Draw ONE single square character-select portrait (one image, no grid, no frames) of the same character ({description}), in the same pixel-art style but more detailed: chest-up close-up, the face large with a cold, confident stare, one hand formed into a dragon claw beside the face with wisps of black smoke and a gold glow, the head turned three-quarters toward the left, dramatic rim lighting. Solid dark charcoal with a faint gold glow background with a subtle pixel texture, no other characters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no frame.

actions.label: Idle
actions.note: A low, coiled dragon-style kung-fu fighting stance. The feet stay in the same place in every frame; only the body bobs and breathes.
poses: rest pose in the guard stance
body dips about 2 pixels, shoulders relax
returning to the rest pose, very close to frame 1 so the loop is seamless

actions.label: Walk Forward
actions.note: A guarded step toward the LEFT. The character stays centred in its cell (walking in place).
poses: contact: front (left) foot stepping forward, guard up
down: weight shifts, knees bend, body dips slightly
passing: the free leg moves past the planted leg
passing, opposite leg, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Walk Backward
actions.note: A retreating step: still FACING LEFT toward the enemy, guard up, stepping backward (to the right). The character stays centred in its cell.
poses: contact: back (right) foot placed behind, guard up
down: weight shifts, knees bend, body dips slightly
passing: the free leg moves past the planted leg
passing, opposite leg, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Crouch
actions.note: Six clearly DIFFERENT poses going from standing down to kneeling; the feet stay on the same ground line.
poses: standing guard stance exactly as in the reference, full height
half squat, knees bent, head clearly lower than in frame 1
dropping to one knee, the back knee almost touching the ground
kneeling on one knee, guard up, body only about 60 percent as tall as in frame 1

actions.label: Jump
actions.note: The ground line is at the same height in every frame. Frames 1 and 6 have the feet on the ground line; in frames 3, 4 and 5 the whole character is drawn clearly above the ground line. Keep the character horizontally centred in its cell.
poses: anticipation: deep crouch, feet on the ground line
launch: legs extending, feet leaving the ground
rising: whole body above the ground line, knees tucked
landing: feet back on the ground line, knees bent absorbing the impact

actions.label: Block High
actions.note: Feet stay planted. The block pose is held from frame 3 onward.
poses: guard stance, starting to raise both forearms
both forearms raised with hands in dragon claws in front of the face
block held: both forearms raised with hands in dragon claws in front of the face and chest, body braced

actions.label: Block Low
actions.note: Feet stay on the ground line. Goes from standing to a LOW crouching block held from frame 3 onward.
poses: crouching low, forearms lowering in front of the knees
block held: deep low crouch, forearms guarding the shins, body only about 60 percent as tall as in frame 1

actions.label: Hit High
actions.note: Struck in the face from the LEFT, recoiling backward to the RIGHT; feet stay near the ground line.
poses: impact: head snaps back, eyes shut
maximum recoil: torso bent far back, one foot sliding
back in the guard stance with a pained face

actions.label: Dragon Claw
actions.note: A fast clawed-hand swipe toward the LEFT at face height. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: strike: the dragon claw raking forward to the LEFT at face height
full extension: the dragon claw raking forward to the LEFT at face height, a short white impact streak

actions.label: Dragon Tail
actions.note: A spinning low sweep kick along the ground toward the LEFT. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: guard stance, weight shifting onto the back leg
wind-up, body turning, the kicking leg chambered
kick: the leg sweeping forward to the LEFT near the ground, a motion arc behind the leg
full extension: the leg sweeping forward to the LEFT near the ground

actions.label: Dragon Awakens
actions.note: Powering up in place; feet stay planted. Black smoke swirls around him in the shape of a coiling dragon, with a gold glow on his fists (black and gold only).

actions.label: Black Dragon Fist
actions.note: IMPORTANT: NINE frames in a 3x3 grid (3 columns and 3 ROWS). A three-hit combo toward the LEFT. The strike frames are 3, 5 and 7; frames 4, 6 and 8 are transitions. Black smoke and a gold glow follow the fists (black and gold only).
poses: first hit: a rushing dragon punch with black smoke toward the LEFT
second hit: a rising uppercut with a gold glow toward the LEFT
third hit, the finisher: a double-fist strike releasing a large black-smoke dragon head with gold eyes toward the LEFT, a large burst

actions.label: Knockdown
actions.note: Hit from the LEFT, falling backward to the RIGHT, ending lying on the back with the head to the right and the feet to the left. The lying body must fit inside its cell.
poses: hitting the ground on the back, dust puff
lying flat, head to the right, feet to the left
